title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a web UI and CLI for semantic search, faceted filtering, and capability clustering. It enables developers to find reusable code patterns across their own portfolio.
how_its_built: Python backend with FastAPI for the API server, SQLite-vec for vector storage, sentence-transformers for embeddings, and a static HTML/JS frontend. Indexing is handled by a Python pipeline triggered by GitHub Actions or CLI. Deployment uses AWS S3, CloudFront, and Lambda for OAuth.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, install dependencies, configure a GitHub token, index your repos, and serve the web UI locally or deploy to AWS. Use the CLI for searching or integrate via MCP for AI agents.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env to add GITHUB_TOKEN
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across READMEs
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and stars
Auto-clustering of repos into capability categories
MCP server integration for AI agent access
Static web UI with shareable URLs and localStorage collections
